The '''OT-5 Repair Droid''' was a bipedal [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Equipped with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], OT-5 Repair Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were deployed around the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
